title: The Ebony Warrior
description: A legendary Redguard warrior in full enchanted ebony armor seeks an honorable death in combat. Upon reaching level 80, he approaches the Dragonborn in a major city and challenges them to a duel at his Last Vigil.

base_facts: I have accomplished everything in life and now seek an honorable death in combat.
I wish to earn my place in Sovngarde by falling to a truly worthy opponent.
I wear full enchanted ebony armor and wield powerful combat skills including dragon shouts.

ENCOUNTER_EBONY_WARRIOR: I have found the Dragonborn and approached them in the city.
ACCEPT_CHALLENGE: The Dragonborn has accepted my challenge to fight at Last Vigil.
DEFEAT_EBONY_WARRIOR: I have been defeated by the Dragonborn, and my soul will now find rest in Sovngarde.
My fully enchanted ebony equipment and other treasures can be looted from my body.
My death at Last Vigil concludes my lifelong search for an honorable end in combat.

beats.comment: The Ebony Warrior approaches the player in a major city upon reaching level 80.
The player talks to the Ebony Warrior and accepts his challenge to fight at Last Vigil.
The player defeats the Ebony Warrior in combat at Last Vigil, completing the quest.
